title: koeleria cristata var. gracillima
intro: Koeleria cristata var. gracillima, commonly known as slender hair-grass, is a type of perennial grass. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata var. gracillima include its antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs and other respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
